hard_constraints.description: Use SwiftData for recording history persistence.
Store SwiftData data in Application Support.
Do not implement audio transcription or transcript display in this task.
Preserve the existing menu-bar-only app behavior; adding history must not introduce a Dock-primary application flow.

subtasks.title: Create SwiftData history model and Application Support container
subtasks.description: Add the RecordingHistoryItem model and a small model-container setup boundary that stores the SwiftData database under Application Support.
validation_criteria: VC1 [AC-4]: SwiftData ModelContainer configuration points to an Application Support URL and creates the required directory if missing.
VC2 [INV-3]: RecordingHistoryItem exposes timestamp, duration, and audioFileURL to callers, even if the URL is persisted internally as a path string.
VC3 [INV-4]: The SwiftData store path is separate from the user-selected audio output directory.
VC4 [HC-1]: The persistence implementation uses SwiftData @Model/ModelContainer rather than UserDefaults or ad-hoc files.
VC5 [HC-2]: The store URL is under FileManager Application Support for the app.
subtasks.test_strategy: Build in Xcode or with xcodebuild; inspect the model-container setup and, if feasible, launch once to confirm the Application Support directory/store is created.
subtasks.aag_contract: Actor -> add SwiftData RecordingHistoryItem and Application Support container setup -> app has a durable history store contract

subtasks.title: Insert history records on successful recording completion
subtasks.description: Wire RecordingState to insert exactly one history record after successful manual stop and successful external stop, while excluding cancel/failure paths.
validation_criteria: VC1 [AC-1]: Manual stop inserts a SwiftData record using the savedURL and final in-memory duration.
VC2 [AC-2]: External successful stop inserts a SwiftData record using the callback savedURL and final in-memory duration.
VC3 [AC-3]: cancelRecording and error paths do not insert history records.
VC4 [INV-1]: Insert happens only after a finalized saved audio URL exists.
VC5 [INV-2]: Failed, cancelled, or partial recordings are not persisted as history.
VC6 [CCR-2]: Both manual and external stop paths use the same insertion helper or equivalent shared behavior.
subtasks.test_strategy: Build, then manually record/stop and verify a history row appears; cancel a recording and verify no row is added; review external-stop path wiring.
subtasks.aag_contract: RecordingState -> insert history item after successful savedURL stop paths -> completed recordings become durable history entries

subtasks.title: Expose a separate history window from the menu-bar app
subtasks.description: Add a separate SwiftUI window scene for recording history and a menu-bar action to open it without changing the app into a Dock-primary app.
validation_criteria: VC1 [AC-5]: Menu-bar UI exposes an action that opens a separate history window.
VC2 [HC-4]: Existing MenuBarExtra behavior and settings scene remain intact.
VC3 [CCR-1]: New Swift files and scene/view references are included in the app target/project so the app builds.
subtasks.test_strategy: Build and run; use the menu-bar action to confirm a distinct history window opens while the menu-bar app remains the primary entry point.
subtasks.aag_contract: MenuBarView/WhispererApp -> add history Window scene and open action -> user can open recording history separately

subtasks.title: Build recording history list and search UI
subtasks.description: Create the history view that queries persisted recording items, displays them newest-first, and filters by visible metadata without introducing transcription UI.
validation_criteria: VC1 [AC-6]: History window renders persisted recordings newest first with date/time, duration, and file name/path affordance.
VC2 [AC-7]: Search field filters visible rows by recording metadata such as date text or file name/path.
VC3 [AC-8]: View code contains no transcript field, no transcription text rendering, and no transcription model dependency.
VC4 [HC-3]: Screenshot-inspired UI excludes transcription, waveform, and player controls from this task.
subtasks.test_strategy: Build and run; create at least one history record, open history window, verify newest-first ordering and search filtering; inspect code for no transcription fields/UI.
subtasks.aag_contract: RecordingHistoryView -> query and filter SwiftData history items -> user sees searchable recording list
